for(outcomeInd in seq_len(nrow(outcomes))){

  outcomeName <- outcomes$cohortFriendlyName[outcomeInd]
  
incidence <- OhdsiReportGenerator::getIncidenceRates(
    connectionHandler = connectionHandler,

    targetIds = ciIds,
    outcomeIds = outcomeId
)

if(nrow(incidence) > 0 ){
  # add outcome tab
  cat(paste0('\n\n### ',outcomeName, ' \n\n'))

tars <- OhdsiReportGenerator:::getTars(
  data = incidence
  )

# add text for tabs
cat('\n::: {.panel-tabset .nav-pills}\n')
for(tarInfo in tars){
  
  idata <- incidence %>% 
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$ageGroupName == 'Any' &
      .data$genderName == 'Any' &
      .data$startYear == 'Any' &
      .data$tarStartWith == tarInfo$tarStartWith  &
      .data$tarStartOffset == tarInfo$tarStartOffset &
      .data$tarEndWith == tarInfo$tarEndWith &
      .data$tarEndOffset ==  tarInfo$tarEndOffset
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      'databaseName',
      'targetName',
      'targetId',
      'cleanWindow',
      #'ageGroupName',
      #'genderName',
      #'startYear',
      'personsAtRisk',
      'personDays',
      'personOutcomes',
      'outcomes',
      'incidenceProportionP100p',
      'incidenceRateP100py'
    )
  
  # if there is data
  if( nrow(idata) > 0 ){
        cat(paste0('\n\n#### TAR: ',paste0('(',tarInfo$tarStartWith, " + ", tarInfo$tarStartOffset, ') - (', tarInfo$tarEndWith, " + ", tarInfo$tarEndOffset, ')'),'\n\n'))
    
    OhdsiReportGenerator::printReactable(
  data = idata, 
columns = list(
  targetName = reactable::colDef(minWidth = 300),
  personOutcomes = reactable::colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
    if (value == -5) "< 5" else value
  }
    ),
  outcomes = reactable::colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
    if (value == -5) "< 5" else value
  }
    ),
  incidenceProportionP100p = reactable::colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
    if (value < 0 ){paste0("<",round(abs(value), digits = 3))}else{round(value, digits = 3)}
  }
    ),
  incidenceRateP100py = reactable::colDef(
    cell = function(value) {
    if (value < 0 ){paste0("<",round(abs(value), digits = 3))}else{round(value, digits = 3)}
  }
    )
),
 highlight = TRUE, 
 striped = TRUE, 
 defaultPageSize = defaultPageSize, 
searchable = TRUE, 
filterable = TRUE
)
cat("\n")
}
